note: Old-town streets after rain. Six rounds. The fix was narrowing the pool to canal, bridge, stair and arch scenes with no shop face, which ended the invented lettered signage: zero in the final five.
One dwelling lit from inside, in its landscape, at dusk or night. Passed in two rounds, the strongest first-time batch of the build.
A fantasy place you would want to visit: floating isles, glass-crown towers, tree villages. Passed in two rounds once crystals stopped being described by their facets.
Night lit by one small warm source under a big dark sky. Passed once the prompt was made to say plainly that it is night. This is the one path that drops flux-1.1-pro-ultra.
An interior with a view, the room is the whole world. Passed in four rounds. Two renders in its batch scored 4.9.

Ancient ruins reclaimed by nature. Five rounds. Turning the ruin three-quarters to the camera killed the mirrored facade; the last fix was a light described as nets, which rendered a literal golden mesh.
A cool old machine cruising or parked in a beautiful place. Three rounds to kill two vehicle lettering priors, then one to push the ride back to mid-distance.
Big natural landforms as pixel paintings. Seven rounds. Replaces the old epic-vista, which has left the rotation.
Balloons, canvas airships, kites and gliders over a landscape, the banded sky filling most of the frame. A clause naming the vessel's own pixel surface rescued the smooth-prone models.
The edge of the sea by day. Five rounds: flat heroes given a standing object, and moon halos stopped rendering as solid rings.
Boats, water and the places built beside them. Passed, then re-passed after your flat-marina flag with an eighteen-entry dullness sweep of the sky, light and marina pools.
